newsitem.title: GREECE: DRACHMA FIRMS VS ECU, $, MARK AT GREEK FIX - DEALERS.
newsitem.headline: DRACHMA FIRMS VS ECU, $, MARK AT GREEK FIX - DEALERS.

text.p: The drachma gained ground against the ecu settling at 311 in today's fixing from 312 on Thursday and advanced against the mark standing at 159.935 from 160.200 on Thursday, dealers said.
"Ecu/drachma settled at 311 after opening at 310.64," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank. "It was very quiet today with the central bank selling a token amount of ecus for drachmas."
Ecu/drachma was trading around 311.25/35 after the fixing, dealers said.
"The central bank did not show it wanted ecu/drachma much lower than 311 and the market pushed it a bit higher after the fixing," the dealer said.
The drachma rose against the U.S. dollar settling at 271.25 from Thursday's 272.920.
